judge_notes.opus5: Two peers printed the same quarter on 5 and 6 November, after VFF last spoke in August - Aurora international medical a record +44%, Canopy international +141%, both on Germany and Poland - into a three-analyst bar that sits flat on Q2 and has under-modelled revenue by 13-15% on each of the last three prints, every one of which was bought (+13.9%, +16.9%, +34.3%). Sized down for the 16% five-day run and Aurora's margin compression.
judge_notes.opus55: Aurora and Canopy, reporting after VFF spoke, show European medical demand accelerating, against a flat three-analyst bar that has under-modelled VFF's export ramp three prints running (each beat was bought); the +16% five-day run and margin pressure trim it.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Three-analyst consensus flat on Q2 while exports ramp and Aurora/Canopy international prints strong; last three beats bought; part priced in +16% 5d run.
judge_notes.fable51: Items 0 and 2: Aurora and Canopy reported accelerating European medical demand after VFF last spoke while a three-analyst consensus sits flat on Q2 after under-modelling three straight beats that were each bought double digits; the +16% five-day run and Aurora's margin squeeze take some of it back.
